chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: If you follow the stock market, you may have noticed that when news comes out

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: about a particular company, its stock price can change considerably.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Why is that?

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Well, the stock price is, of course, the main mechanism by which investors

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: can essentially let their view of the stock be known.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: In other words, if they think that the company is valued less,

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: they're going to sell and the price is going to go down.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: If investors think the value of the company should go up,

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: they're going to buy the stock and the price is going to go up.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Now, why is it that this information or news affects the stock price?

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: It's based on these things that we've covered up to now in the lesson.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: In other words, intrinsic value, book value, and, well,

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: of course, market capitalization.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: But let's take a look at how it affects, say, intrinsic value.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Consider a company run by this CEO and assume for the moment that his business,

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: his company, is to grow and sell coconuts.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: What if the following news comes out?

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: The CEO is ill.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Maybe he has cancer.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Maybe he's got something else that prevents him from collecting those coconuts

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: as effectively as he might otherwise do.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Well, certainly that should affect the stock price downward.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Because the probability that we are going to get dividends in the future is decreasing.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Either that or the amount of the dividends is going to decrease.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: So if you think back to the intrinsic valuation that we talked about,

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: the potential for reduced future dividends reduces the value of the company significantly.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Now consider another scenario where there's an island with our original company and

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: another company.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: And news comes out about the soil on the island being contaminated.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: That news is going to affect not only our original company, but

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: also all the other companies on the island.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: So you can think of this sort of news as being sector news.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: In other words, it relates to the sector of growing coconuts on this island.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: And it affects all the companies in the sector.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Let's consider one last scenario where we have many islands with many companies on those islands.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: And news that might affect all of them, like sea level rising.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: That is going to negatively impact all of these companies.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: So we have examples here of company specific news that affects the price of a individual company.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Sector specific news that affects, say, the companies on a particular island or

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: in a particular industrial segment.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: And market wide news that affects all the companies in the market.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: So that's how news can affect the prices of the stock.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: Primarily because they reduce the expectation of future dividends.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: We've seen how that can affect the intrinsic value.

chunks.title: Why information affects stock price
chunks.text: And accordingly, why people would want to pay less for that stock.
